If the car turns off or the connection drops, HeadQLink keeps listening and leaves Android Auto paused for this long: if the car comes back, the picture returns instantly, without unlocking. Automatic: HeadQLink starts and stops the Android Auto server by itself, with its accessibility service. Manual: no accessibility; you start it yourself (Android Auto › ⋮ › Start head unit server) after every phone restart or Android Auto update, and HeadQLink never stops it: it stays on between trips and the next one uses it again without a restart, even with the phone locked. If it ever does not answer (off, or blocked by a connection that was cut halfway), HeadQLink tells you and retries by itself: stop it and start it again (⋮ › Stop head unit server and ⋮ › Start head unit server). On a public Wi-Fi, any device on that network could try to connect: stop it when you are not using it. Applies immediately.

Manual start of the Android Auto server

Without accessibility, HeadQLink neither starts nor stops the Android Auto server:

• Start it yourself (Android Auto › ⋮ › Start head unit server) after every phone restart or Android Auto update.
• HeadQLink always closes Android Auto in an orderly way, so the server keeps answering: it works for the following trips without a restart, even with the phone locked. If it ever does not answer (off, or blocked by a connection that was cut halfway), HeadQLink tells you and retries by itself: stop it and start it again.
• It stays on until you stop it. On a public Wi-Fi, any device on that network could try to connect: stop it when you are not in the car (⋮ › Stop head unit server).

Automatic start is still the recommended mode. You can go back to it in Picture settings › Advanced.
How to start the Android Auto server

1. Tap "Open AA".
2. Tap ⋮ (top right) › "Start head unit server".
3. If that option is missing: scroll to the bottom, tap "Version" 10 times, accept the warning and repeat step 2.
4. Come back to HeadQLink and connect. HeadQLink does not check it beforehand (a test connection would block it): if Android Auto does not answer with the car, it tells you and retries every 5 s.
Do it after every phone restart or Android Auto update: between trips it stays on and works without a restart. If HeadQLink says it does not answer: ⋮ › "Stop head unit server" and ⋮ › "Start head unit server".
